title: Reconcile to the latest harness and read built backlog views
goal: The coordinator runs the latest harness release and its solution tools read components' built backlog views
acceptance: Started only once the project-harness template backlog is empty (external prerequisite; harness 10.9.0 has no cross-repository dependsOn)
.harness.json names the latest release; tools/solution.mjs and docs/agents/solution-profile.md are at 10.14.0 or later
npm run solution:refresh reads a component with built views (NERV once nerv:F-125 switches) from its backlog-views publication
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Component repositories are read, never written.
validation: check:fast; npm test; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption
Do not start while the template backlog still has open work

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: reconcile from 10.9.0, mostly copied tools, plus one refresh against a built view. Not a measurement.
